attributes.board_name: North Dakota State Board of Dental Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Publications, seminars, symposiums, lectures, college courses and online education; clinical dentistry subject matter accepted without limit; certificates must name provider, date and hours
rules.audit_note: Renewal application includes proof of CE completion (NDCC 43-20-01.4). Board may audit; keep records from the previous cycle.

topics.who: Ethics or jurisprudence; passing the laws and rules exam counts as 2 h
Can be met by a federal OSHA course for dental providers
Hands-on CPR course and current CPR certificate

rules.notes: Max 8 h self-study; other hours via real-time webinars or classroom. Hands-on CPR course and current CPR certificate required. Extra 2 h: anesthesia permit (sedation), restorative permit (restorative), general supervision (medical emergencies). Max 1 h practice management.
